children: Japanese stocks may fall, tracking Wall Street's losses on Friday. Concerns among investors including those in Japan appear to be mounting over whether companies can generate sufficient AI-related profits to meet increasingly rising credit obligations. Nikkei futures opened 1,615 points lower at 63990 on the SGX. The dollar is at 157.83 yen versus Y157.86 around Friday's Tokyo market close. The Nikkei Stock Average closed 1.4% higher at 65324.29 on Friday. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)

This article was corrected at 0017 GMT to reflect that Japanese stocks may fall, tracking Wall Street's losses on Friday. The original article incorrectly said they may track Wall Street's losses overnight.

Japanese stocks may fall, tracking Wall Street's losses on Friday. "Nikkei May Fall, Tracking Wall Street's Losses — Market Talk," at 2338 GMT, incorrectly said they may track Wall Street's losses overnight.
